options.text: ความหมาย: If a care instruction changes after the doctor's round, I make sure the patient is told about the change before they notice it themselves.
ความหมาย: If a patient's discharge requires assistive devices, I confirm availability before the planned departure day, not only on the morning of discharge.
ความหมาย: When a patient cannot rate their condition numerically, I use verbal description and functional ability as complementary assessment methods.
ความหมาย: When assessing a medication adverse effect, I ask about the onset, intensity, and impact on everyday life before drawing conclusions about the connection.
